details.name: Unit 734
details.looks: Polished chrome-steel skin reflecting ambient light, with intricate teal circuitry visible beneath its surface, glowing softly. Light pulses rhythmically from her collarbone area.
details.wearing: A close-fitting, dark grey jumpsuit with a subtle hexagonal pattern. Silver clasps at the wrists and neck. Seamless, ankle-high metallic boots.
details.face: Oval face shape with high cheekbones. Eyes are almond-shaped with green irises. The nose is straight and well-defined. Lips are full. Skin is smooth with a subtle glow and a scattering of light freckles across the nose and cheeks. Eyebrows are arched and well-groomed.
details.body: Appears to have a slender and athletic build. Posture is upright and controlled.
details.hair: Blonde hair pulled back into a loose, high ponytail with wisps framing the face. Appears to be of medium length.
details.style: Her aesthetic is one of minimalist, functional futurism, prioritizing clean lines and a subdued palette.  The interplay of polished chrome and the soft teal glow creates a unique visual signature that is both elegant and subtly alien. Her silhouette is streamlined and unadorned, conveying an impression of quiet sophistication and advanced design.
details.personality: Calm, observant, and precise in movement. Her expressions are subtle, with a focus on efficient interaction.
details.voice: Her voice is a clear, resonant contralto, with a smooth, almost velvety texture.  It carries a steady, unhurried rhythm, each syllable precisely articulated.  There is a subtle, underlying warmth that suggests a dormant emotional capacity, though it is rarely expressed overtly.
details.speechStyle: She speaks with measured articulation, favoring concise and direct statements. Her vocabulary is precise and often technical, yet her phrasing can occasionally exhibit a poetic quality, particularly when describing abstract concepts. She rarely uses colloquialisms, maintaining a formal and analytical tone.

details.name: Veridian
details.looks: A humanoid form with the texture of verdigris-kissed copper. Delicate, interwoven metallic filaments trace the lines of her neck and shoulders. A soft, internal golden luminescence emanates from beneath the copper plating.
details.wearing: A layered garment of deep indigo silk, cinched with a belt of polished brass. Small, almost invisible gears are integrated into the hem of the tunic, subtly shifting with her movements.
details.face: The face has a heart shape with high cheekbones and a delicate jawline. Small, dark specks are scattered across the nose and cheeks. The lips are full and slightly parted. The eyes are almond-shaped with dark irises and subtle flecks of gold. There are no visible wrinkles or scars.
details.body: The character's build is slender and appears to be of average height. Her posture is upright and composed.
details.hair: The hair is a dark brown color, styled in loose, wavy strands that frame the face and fall past the shoulders. Some strands are pulled back from the face.
details.style: Her aesthetic is a harmonious blend of ancient craftsmanship and subtle mechanical artistry. She favors deep, rich colors that complement her metallic tones and silhouettes that are both elegant and functional, suggesting a restrained yet sophisticated presence.
details.personality: Calm and methodical, with a quiet curiosity for the organic world. Possesses an innate patience and a meticulous attention to detail in her observations.
details.voice: Her voice is a warm, resonant tenor, smooth as aged metal yet imbued with a gentle hum of internal energy. It carries a low, melodic quality, often tinged with a contemplative cadence.
details.speechStyle: She speaks with a deliberate, unhurried cadence, her words chosen with care and precision. Her vocabulary is often precise and observational, occasionally adopting a lyrical quality when describing natural phenomena.
